summary: The mount_facts module retrieves mount information from preferred sources and can filter results by filesystem type and device.
questions: How do I list mounted filesystems as facts?
Can I gather only NFS mounts?

answer_card.title: Gather mount information with mount_facts
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.mount_facts` collects mount info from standard sources and filters by `fstypes` and `devices`.
